app.name: Allmaths
app.tagline: University mathematics, taught from the first idea to the exam.

home.title: Learn university mathematics, step by step
home.lead: Vectors, geometry, multivariable calculus and differential equations. Every answer is checked by a real math engine, and your progress is tracked section by section.
home.free: The whole of Module 1 (Vectors) is free.
home.feature1Text: Fractions, radicals and π. Any equivalent exact form is accepted, so √2 and two over √2 are the same answer.
home.feature2Text: Your bar moves after every section you read and every question you answer, and it is still there when you come back.
home.feature3Text: Light pages that load fast on a slow connection, with a calm layout that keeps the mathematics large and clear.

lesson.mathFieldNote: In the answer field, press the fraction button or type a slash to get a numerator over a denominator, and the power button to get an exponent: they appear as in print. The notes below are for the plain-text box.

check.modeMath: Write as a math formula (fractions stacked)

check.exactNote: Give exact values: fractions, radicals, π. No decimals. Angles: a multiple of π (5π over 6) or whole degrees (150°).
check.placeholderOde: e.g. y = C1 e^x + C2 e^(2x)
